chapter.heading: Sing to the LORD a New Song(Psalms 98:1–9; Isaiah 42:10–17)
chapter.v:
Hallelujah!Sing to
the LORD a new song—His praise in the assembly of the godly.

Let Israel
rejoice in their Maker;let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.

Let them
praise His name with dancing,and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.

For the
LORD takes pleasure in His people;He adorns the afflicted with salvation.

Let the
saints exult in glory;let them shout for joy upon their beds.

May the
high praises of God be in their mouths,and a double-edged sword in their hands,

to inflict
vengeance on the nationsand punishment on the peoples,

to bind
their kings with chainsand their nobles with shackles of iron,

to execute
the judgment written against them.This honor is for all His saints.Hallelujah!
